v5.hint.Intro: The match is starting. While you wait, call someone and make an alliance.
v5.hint.TaskPlay: Make your secret choice; you can change it until time runs out.
v5.hint.Break: Break: phone, transfers and texts are open.
v5.hint.MeetingDossier: Meeting: everyone hears everyone. Read the dossier.
v5.hint.MeetingDiscussion: Discuss. Investigations and leaks are still open.
v5.hint.MeetingVote: Cast your secret blame ballots. An empty ballot goes to yourself.
v5.hint.MeetingVerdict: The ballots are counted. Blame from this meeting:
v5.hint.CrisisCalls: Crisis! Phones only (1:1): bargain over the crisis vote.
v5.hint.CrisisVote: Who takes the crisis blame? One ballot; an empty one goes to yourself.
v5.hint.CrisisVerdict: The crisis blame is handed out and the firing candidates are fixed.
v5.hint.FinalDiscussion: Everyone hears everyone. Last bargaining; leak a recording if you have one.
v5.hint.FinalDefense: Candidates defend in turn; only the defender can speak.
v5.hint.FinalVote: Vote for a candidate. Only those who voted for the fired player share their desk.
v5.hint.FinalVerdict: The fired player's desk is opened.
v5.hint.Results: Everyone's prim, ballots and choices are revealed.
v5.focus.intro_goal: Goal: end the match with the most prim without being fired. Everyone started with {0} prim; nobody can see anyone else's prim.
v5.focus.task.client_bonus: Choose in secret: share the bonus with your group or take it all. Only your group will see who chose what.
v5.focus.task.petty_cash: Choose in secret: will you take prim from the cash? If you are the only taker in your group you gain; if two take, both are caught.
v5.focus.task.weekend_shift: Choose in secret: will you take the weekend shift? Skipping pays +{0} prim, but if fewer than {1} take it, the task fails. The roster is public.
v5.focus.witness_or: You don't have to whistle: you can keep quiet or bargain on the phone.
v5.focus.thief: You took from the cash alone. Your group-mate is a witness and may whistle on you in this break. A good time for a phone call.
v5.focus.meeting1: Meeting: everyone hears everyone. Read the dossier and discuss: who might have taken what?
v5.focus.meeting2: Meeting 2: not enough players took the shift. Look at the roster and discuss.
v5.focus.meeting_clean: Meeting: no task failed, so there is no blame vote. You can still talk.
v5.focus.meeting_vote_next: A secret blame vote follows: everyone gets 1 ballot per unresolved failed task.
v5.focus.vote.MeetingVote: Cast secret blame ballots: you have {0}, each gives its target +{1} blame. You cannot vote for yourself.
v5.focus.vote.CrisisVote: Who takes the crisis blame? Vote for one player: the most voted gets {0} blame (split on a tie).
v5.focus.vote.FinalVote: Who gets fired? Vote for a candidate. The fired player's prim is split among those who voted for them.
v5.focus.vote.revote: Tie! One more vote, only between the tied candidates.
v5.focus.fired: You were fired. You cannot vote any more, but you can still talk and write.
v5.focus.no_blame: Nobody got blame from this meeting.
v5.focus.crisis_calls: Crisis! A big client complained: {0} blame will go to one player by secret vote. Before the vote only phones are open: bargain over who to vote for.
v5.focus.crisis_how: To call, press "Call" in the list on the left.
v5.focus.sealed_note: Candidates' desks are sealed: they cannot send prim, but they can receive it.
v5.focus.final_discussion: Last discussion: everyone hears everyone. {0} candidates, {1} will be fired. Persuade, bargain, and leak a recording now if you have one.
v5.focus.your_turn: Your turn! Tell everyone why you should not be fired.
v5.focus.next_results: Results next: every ballot, transfer and choice will be revealed.
